category: other: dislodged on retreat - after a long hold at the target, the fingers re-closed on the tipping kettle and lifted it 17 cm, and it fell on its side off the burner
what_happened: Scene: copper kettle on the counter right of a 5-burner induction cooktop (pan in the centre). Stage 0: grasp 112, lift 0.215 m, kettle over the left burner by 224 (at_target from 224). It then held the kettle on or just above the burner ring 224-459, about 235 steps (12 s). The wrist shows the handle in the fingers and the kettle on the ring with almost no motion. (Successes hold 0-97 steps before releasing.) At 459 the gripper opened (0.023 m from the centre). At 460-476 the kettle tilted toward the gripper and the fingers closed again on its rim/handle (hold 468-490). The arm rose 484-492, lifting the kettle 0.17 m with it hanging tilted, and at ~490-500 it fell (drop 0.116 m). It came to rest on its side at the rear-left of the cooktop, 0.16-0.18 m from the burner centre. Stage 0 held briefly at 501-522 (lying kettle within 15 cm) and was then lost as the kettle settled farther away. Stage 1: 572-692 the gripper went to the front-left knob and turned it to only 0.05 rad. 700-1000 it raised the arm and looked around (wall, hood). It made no attempt to right or re-place the kettle.
causal_chain: held the kettle on the burner 224-459 instead of releasing -> after release, fingers re-closed on the tipping kettle (468) and lifted it 17 cm while retreating -> kettle fell on its side off the burner centre (~490-500) -> stage 0 undone at 522 -> knob nudged to 0.05 rad (572-692), then wandered; kettle not on a burner at the end
self_recovery: none for the fallen kettle. The policy went to the knob as if stage 0 were done, and that knob turn was also insufficient (0.05 rad).
official_criterion_notes: Stage 0 counted as complete 501-522 with the kettle lying on its side; the official check has no upright test, so a lit burner in that window could have scored a toppled kettle. Hold 1 height_drop_after_release_m = -0.068 because the kettle was re-lifted within 2 s; it is not a real rise.

packet_facts: holds: grasp 112 release 459 lift 0.215 dist 0.023; grasp 468 release 490 lift 0.169 dist 0.222 drop 0.116

uncertain_about: Whether the gripper deliberately re-grasped at 468 or the fingers never fully cleared the handle (touch is almost continuous 452-489). The arm blocks the landing 504-560; 'on its side' is clear from 600 on.
